newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close steady amid cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close steady amid cautious trading.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed steady as few of the blue chip shares gained amid cautious trading ahead of the weekend, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index gained 0.22 points or 0.02 percent at 1,048.02 on a turnover of 33.8 million taka on Thursday. Losers led gainers by 72 to 55.
"The market sentiment was very week after the submission of the resignation letter by the chief of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)," said one broker.
"The resignation has dampened the market sentiment. SEC chief took many steps to boost the capital market," he said.
Brokers said gains by some blue chips prevented the index from falling. They said there was no good new that could prop up the market.
"The investros are extremely under pressure by the banks to pay off the loans which they took against their shares," said another broker.
Bangladesh Lamps gained 95 taka to 4,770, Bata Shoe fall 0.15 to 123.85 and Excelsior Shoes lost 0.55 to 112.06.
The market will remain closed on Friday and Saturday for weekend.
